title: Resting heart rate
steps: Rest quietly for at least 10 minutes before measuring.
Use two fingers to find your pulse on the thumb side of your wrist.
Count beats for one full minute and enter the result in beats per minute. Leave the field blank if the reading is unavailable.

title: Blood pressure
steps: Use the approved upper-arm monitor with the correct cuff size on a bare arm.
Rest quietly for five minutes. Support the arm with the cuff at heart level and stay still and quiet during the reading.
Enter the upper and lower readings from the same cuff cycle in mmHg. Leave both fields blank if the measurement fails.

title: Blood oxygen
steps: Use the approved fingertip pulse oximeter on a warm, relaxed hand as directed by the device.
Keep still and wait for the oxygen saturation reading to settle.
Enter SpO₂ in percent. Leave it blank if there is no stable reading.

title: Body temperature
steps: Use the approved digital oral thermometer and place the probe under the tongue.
Close your mouth and wait for the device to signal that the reading is ready.
Enter the oral reading in degrees Celsius. Leave it blank if it is unavailable.
